## Security & Hygiene Notes

- Keep `.env` untracked (gitignored); commit only synthetic placeholders in `.env.example` (`@contoso.com`).
- Prefer Microsoft Entra delegated/managed credentials or Azure Key Vault secret names over raw API keys.
